content.short: Flashnet is non-custodial Bitcoin orchestration for onramps, offramps, swaps and cross-chain transfers.
content.description: Flashnet routes onramps, offramps, swaps and cross-chain transfers through one non-custodial API with a Bitcoin focus. Monad's documentation lists it under both cross-chain tooling and onramps. Bitcoin-centred infrastructure sits slightly apart from the EVM tooling world, since the absence of general smart contracts forces different designs for the same problems.
